title: Phoritto (Pho + Burrito)
description: This phoritto (pho + burrito) recipe is packed with steak, rice noodles, savory-sweet sauce, and Thai basil — a tasty adaptation of Vietnamese cuisine.
ingredients: 1 pound frozen ribeye steak, thinly sliced
2 tablespoons hoisin sauce, or to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onions; cook and stir until softened, about 5 minutes. Add jalapeños; cook and stir until dark green, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Heat broth in a separate saucepan over medium-high heat. Cook ribeye slices in hot broth in batches until medium-rare, 10 to 20 seconds per batch.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add noodles; cook until tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Drain.
Place tortillas on a microwave-safe plate. Microwave until warm, 20 to 25 seconds.

Divide jalapeño mixture, ribeye slices, noodles, chili-garlic sauce, bean sprouts, hoisin sauce, Thai basil, and cilantro among warmed tortillas; spoon broth on top. Fold opposing side edges of tortillas to overlap the filling, then roll opposing edges around the filling creating burritos. Serve with lime slices.

video.description: All the fragrant and spiciness of Vietnamese pho is reconstructed as a delicious filling for a handy sandwich wrap! Cook onions and jalapenos, then cook strips of ribeye steak medium rare in simmering beef pho broth. Boil vermicelli rice noodles, and warm up some flour tortillas. Finally, bring around the family and friends and assemble: Fill each tortilla with onion and jalapeno mixture, ribeye slices, vermicelli, chili-garlic sauce, crunchy bean sprouts, sweet hoisin sauce, Thai basil and cilantro. Spoon some broth on top, add a drizzle of Sriracha, and serve with lime slices. Then eat to your good health!
